clue.text: Grand ball — test for sexism?

clue.text: See 24

definitions.text: seats quite near to the stage?

parts.note: taken as written, as fodder

parts.note: taken as written, as fodder

clue.text: 'RI's out' — wayward, historic St Lewis's people?

clue.text: Scold Democrat Sharp

parts.note: a shrew is a nagging, scolding woman

clue.text: Bomb container

taken as written
